$description: DHCW Single Record Design System — Primitive typography tokens (Tier 1). Raw scale values only. Never reference these directly in components — use semantic tokens. Scale revised by DDR-005 (supersedes DDR-004): clean 4px-grid line-heights, no off-grid sizes.

size.$description: Font size scale (px). Reference via semantic tokens only.

line-height.$description: Line height scale (px). All values are multiples of 4 — aligned to the 4px base spacing grid (DDR-001).

letter-spacing.$description: Letter spacing values in px. Source of truth: Single Record Figma variables (Font/Letter Spacing/*).

default.$description: No additional tracking — body text and headings

wide.$description: Expanded tracking — labels and UI controls

caption.$description: Gentle expansion — captions and supporting text
